verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Forter ingesting order status updates and chargebacks, but only for dispute handling and evidence recommendations. Nothing documents analyst review decisions or confirmed fraud outcomes being fed back to retrain the model or adjust rules. The note that agentic-order metadata 'improves Forter's risk decisions' is about input data at decision time, not a learning loop from worked cases.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work
